page.layout: One column of running text, set in a single block. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot right and centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: passim in Ephemeridibus omnibus earum gentium manifeste apparet. Ephemerides aliquot habeo, ut alias tibi significavi, & Persicas & Turcicas, singulas autem unius tantum anni confici solent, quemadmodum in Oriente, nam plurium annorum illas simul edere, Typographiae defectu, non facile illis foret: intet[?] has unam quamplurimi praecipuè facio, exactissime elaboratam à Nulla Zeineddin Larita Mathematico & Astronomo inter Persas praestantissimo, mihiqve amicissimo, qui certe, in nostra etiam Europa, inter hujus artis peritos, pares haberet admodum paucos, si libris apud nos à recentioribus editis, instrumentis nuper repertis, ac demum observationibus innumeris, posterioribus hisce seculis factis ad eruditissimis viris, quae omnia in Perside ignorantur, non esset destitutus. Fatebatur mihi quidem, Tabulas Astronomicas recentiores, quibus ipsi nunc utuntur, confectas ab Olegh Chan, Samarcand Principe, & magni illius Tei-mur Lenk, hoc est, Teimur Claudi, quem

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "intet" in the line "non facile illis foret: intet has" is hard to read at this scan resolution; the word is uncertain. "Olegh" is printed with a break in the letters ("Oleg h"); read as "Olegh". The page is a scan with show-through and edge marks on the left and right, which are not transcribed.
